title: Parātrīśikā nights — one power per phoneme, two phonemes per night
provenance: Vowel powers per Jaideva Singh's Parātrīśikāvivaraṇa exposition ('Explanation of the vowels which are of the nature of Siva'). Loci per TĀ 15 verse-literal matrika map. ṝ/ḷ/ḹ carry no separate gloss in this recension table — held as breath/silence at locus (PEDAGOGICAL, consistent with void-pause treatment). Nightly order: install a→aḥ (sṛṣṭi); the kṣa→a withdrawal comes later.

phonemes.power: cit — consciousness itself, anuttara, the unsurpassable ground
phonemes.cue: a — open, rest as the ground

phonemes.power: ānanda — bliss, the ground enjoying itself
icchā — will to manifest, still untouched by objectivity
phonemes.cue: i — will stirs, nothing yet seen

phonemes.power: īśāna — mastery; will now coloured by objectivity
unmeṣa — jñānaśakti, the power of knowledge opening
ūnatā — waning of knowledge, whence object-appearance begins
amṛtabīja — the imperishable seed, subject to no change
held in the amṛta field — no separate gloss in this recension; breathe, do not substitute
śūnya-pause — binds nothing; rest at the locus, no sound
śūnya-pause — binds nothing; rest at the locus, no sound
asphuṭa kriyāśakti — indistinct power of activity
sphuṭa kriyāśakti — distinct power of activity
sphuṭatara kriyāśakti — more distinct power of activity
sphuṭatama kriyāśakti — most distinct power of activity
Śiva-bindu — undivided knowledge of the universe, the holder
phonemes.cue: aṃ — gather everything to a point

phonemes.power: visarga — emission itself; lower dot Śakti (world expands), upper dot Śiva (all rests in I-consciousness)
phonemes.cue: aḥ — release; the world rests in I
